c.tagline: Loire-side city of mechanical elephants and Breton dukes.

taxi.fareNote: Official taxis are metered and marked by a lit roof sign; booking via app (Uber, Bolt, FreeNow) or the local Allô Taxi Nantes radio service is easy.

emergency.note: 112 is the EU-wide emergency number connecting to police, fire, and ambulance.

hood_landmark.Bouffay: Château des ducs de Bretagne, Nantes
hood_landmark.Île de Nantes: Machines of the Isle of Nantes

avoid.reason: Watch for pickpockets around Gare de Nantes and the Commerce tram hub, especially late at night.

hood_desc: The elegant 18th- and 19th-century core around the Graslin theatre, the ornate Passage Pommeraye arcade, and the Cours Cambronne; best for first-timers who want shops, cafes, and monuments all on foot.
Nantes' medieval quarter of half-timbered houses and cobbled lanes beside the Château des ducs de Bretagne, packed with bars, bistros, and the city's liveliest nightlife.

The reinvented river island where former shipyards have become galleries and creative studios, home to the Machines of the Isle mechanical elephant and the Carrousel des Mondes Marins; arty and family-friendly.
A leafy residential district north of the center along the Erdre, near the Jardin des Plantes, with calm streets and local markets; a quiet base close to the action.
A former working-class riverside village to the west, now a laid-back neighborhood known for its Sunday Marché de Chantenay and views over the Loire; a local, unhurried feel.
lodging: Auberge de Jeunesse HI Nantes La Manu

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink throughout France.

transit.hours: Trams and the Busway run from around 4:30am to about 12:30am; the Luciole night-bus lines cover late nights on weekends.
transit.pay: The TAN network uses the reloadable LIBERTAN card or paper tickets bought at machines and tabacs; a single ticket costs €1.80 (about US$2) and is valid for one hour with transfers. A 24-hour pass is €5.90. Validate on board.

transit.m: Aéroport shuttle bus (Navette) to Nantes railway station & center, ~20 min
TAN bus line 98 + Tram line 3 to the center, ~40 min

tip.r: Service is included by law ('service compris'); rounding up or leaving ~5-10% for good service is appreciated but not expected.
